Native filtering is unavailable for this device build. Browsing remains available without filtering.
EasyList and EasyPrivacy refresh in the background about weekly when connected. Updates are size-limited, checked before activation, and the last good snapshot is retained if an update fails.

WebView does not expose every request or its full details. Direct page navigation is not filtered. Audio and video requests are blocked only when a filter rule matches. Downloaded lists cannot run scripts or procedural actions. Older providers may apply cosmetic rules after page start.
For YouTube player data, reload after changing this setting. Changes cannot restore data the page has already received.
